decisions.statement: The domains are nested here the way the domains panel nests them.
A thing hangs under the domain that thing names.
A domain with nothing hung beneath it anywhere is left out.
A domain's count is everything hung beneath it rather than every row beneath it.
That count reaches the whole descent rather than what hangs directly.
A thing hung on a domain carries no count of its own.
A domain's own things are drawn after the domains beneath it.
What hangs on one domain keeps the order the caller gave it in.
A thing naming a domain the nesting never reached is drawn as a root of its own.
Every domain named that way is reported unreached as well as drawn.
Nothing here decides what is hung on the domains.
Nothing here reads a file the editor holds.

definition: the domain tree a set of things is hung on, with every domain holding none left out
